title: Airport Security Fast Pass
scenario: A website sells official-looking fast-security passes that are not linked to the airport.

answers.A: Buy the pass from the unaffiliated website before it sells out.
answers.B: Check fast-track access on the airport or airline website.
answers.C: Buy it if the logo and airport name look correct.
answers.D: Ask airport staff where official fast-track passes are sold.

explanation: Airport branding is easy to copy. Verify the seller through the airport or airline before paying.
proTip: Official-looking is not the same as official.
